_note: Two perturbations of the scoring, both recomputed from the same runs/study.jsonl checkpoint on 2026-08-12. 'design' is the complete-case shape each perturbation leaves behind. Only a perturbation that leaves the design unchanged is a matched comparison with the headline.

head_on_truncation.what: recovers the datum from the first line of a response cut off at the token cap instead of discarding it

logistic_ramp.what: replaces the Spearman-Karber switch point with a logistic switch point on I2 and I3
logistic_ramp.why_not_matched: the logistic fit is undefined on cells where a model never switches, so 29.6% of the array goes missing and the complete-case subset loses two instruments as well as three models. A three-instrument design is not the design the headline is estimated on.
